# archestra_model_provider (Data Source)

Finds an LLM provider key that exists already, by `name`, by `llm_provider` and `is_primary`, or both. Exactly one key must match. Use `id` wherever a provider key ID is expected, such as `llm_api_key_id` on `archestra_agent`. The key's secret is never read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A provider key created outside Terraform, found by its exact name.
data "archestra_model_provider" "by_name" {
  name = "Engineering Anthropic Key"
}

# The organization's primary key for one provider.
data "archestra_model_provider" "anthropic_primary" {
  llm_provider = "anthropic"
  is_primary   = true
}

# Use the key's ID where one is expected. The secret is never read.
resource "archestra_agent" "triage" {
  name           = "Issue triage"
  system_prompt  = "Label and route new issues."
  model_id       = data.archestra_model.claude_sonnet.id
  llm_api_key_id = data.archestra_model_provider.anthropic_primary.id
}

data "archestra_model" "claude_sonnet" {
  model_id     = "claude-sonnet-4-5"
  llm_provider = "anthropic"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `is_primary` (Boolean) When set, match only keys that are (`true`) or are not (`false`) their provider's primary key. With `llm_provider`, `true` selects that provider's primary key.
- `llm_provider` (String) Provider the key belongs to, such as `anthropic`.
- `name` (String) Exact name of the key. Set this, `llm_provider`, or both.

### Read-Only

- `base_url` (String) Custom base URL of the key, when it has one.
- `id` (String) ID of the provider key.
- `scope` (String) Who the key is shared with: `personal`, `team` or `org`.
- `team_id` (String) Team the key belongs to, for a team key.
